text: Zul'Farrak (or Zul'farrak), pronounced [ZOOL-fah-rawk], is a Sandfury troll city located in northwestern Tanaris.

, a typical zombie.]] Zombies are a variant of the undead. Most common zombies are humans and trolls, but goblin and high elven zombies have also been encountered. During the Scourge Invasion, adventurers could be transformed into zombies. Others were tasked with bringing back the brain of a zombie for study. Plague eruptors are a type of powerful zombies, designed to spread horror and chaos across the world of the living.
__NOTOC__ Zor Lonetree is an orc located in Grommash Hold in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. He is well schooled in Alliance politics.

Zorbin Fandazzle is a goblin engineering vendor originally located by the docks at the Forgotten Coast in Feralas. He is affiliated with the Steamwheedle Cartel, and quest completion of Zapped Giants and Fuel for the Zapping is required to gain access to his wares. As he claims, doing his repeatable quests are a nice way to gain reputation with the Steamwheedle Cartel. After the Cataclysm washed out the coast, Zorbin moved further inland, northeast of the new Feathermoon Stronghold.

The Zoram Strand is a stretch of beach in the northwest corner of Ashenvale. Prior its destruction during the Great Sundering, it was a night elven city named Zoram. While the Horde have set up a minor outpost (Zoram'gar Outpost) in the Zoram Strand, the area has fallen to the naga. The dark creatures have taken up residence, evident in their numbers and in the shipwrecks and beached sea creatures along the shore. The Zoram Strand is also the site of the Blackfathom Deeps.

Ziz Fizziks is a goblin quest giver who was originally located in a hut in southwestern Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. He used to be a member of the Venture Company, but became so angry when the company hired the gnome Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle that he asked Sputtervalve to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union instead. Sputtervalve set Ziz on a few tasks to prove his loyalty to the Union—including stealing the blueprints to the Venture Company's Super Reaper 6000 and later eliminating Gerenzo himself on behalf of Director Riddlevox—and sent adventurers to help him. After adventurers helped Ziz complete his tests, he hoped that Sputtervalve would assign him to one of the T

.]] .]] Ziggurats are Scourge structures found in many locations. They are towers of the ancient spider kingdom of Azjol-Nerub and were used by the Scourge to provide a source of raw energy for undead forces. The ziggurats of the Third War were technically without protection, for those empowered with a defense crystal were actually spirit towers or nerubian towers. The distinction seems to have been lost since.
Zodiac Gloves are a reward from the quest Look To The Stars (4) which begins with Viktori Prism'Antras in Duskwood.
__NOTOC__ .]] Zorus the Judicator is a draenei quest giver located at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley.

Zones are areas of the map with designated themes, mobs, and scenery. These areas have borders much like a state or country, and though invisible, they define areas. They may contain subzones, cities, towns, villages, or instances. For example, the zone of Dun Morogh contains the subzone of Coldridge Valley, the city Ironforge, the town Kharanos, and the instance Gnomeregan. In lore, novels, the RPG, the [http://www.worldofwarcraft.com official web site], a zone is usually referred to as a region. However, the community has practically adopted the term 'zone' for any reference to the game itself. Furthermore, lore regions and in-game zones do not always match up (what may be a region in lore

Zignie the Insane is a goblin ace. No one knows where this goblin came from, but most along the east coast of Kalimdor learn to fear the power of this aerial pirate. Perhaps the most eccentric of the master aces, Zignie made a name for himself in his own vessel, Ratchet's Wings. His “vessel” consists of nothing more than a large phlogiston engine with guide wings strapped to his back. Controls extend down to his arms and feet, which not only control the speed and direction of the rocket engine, but a pair of autoloading, rapid-firing cannons tacked to the wings. Others often underestimate him, which can prove fatal for caravans and aerial transports; while looking half-cobbled, Zignie and hi

__NOTOC__ Zorbo the Advisor is an ogre mage residing in a cave at the Laughing Skull Ruins in the northern mountains of Nagrand. Along with his Warmaul Reavers and shaman, Zorbo has slain countless orcs and planned numerous attacks on Garadar. Warden Bullrok of Garadar considered the ogre armed, dangerous, and merciless, and thus issued a price on his head on the Garadar Bulletin Board.

Zootfizzle was a Blizzard forum poster focusing on the UI & Macros forum alongside Slouken and Rislyn. Zootfizzle enjoys spending time playing with his sprockets, and compulsively destroys cogs whenever he sees them.
Zivlix's Destruction Machine is a flying machine located at Nozzlerust Post in the Dragonblight.
__NOTOC__ Znort was a kobold that could be found following the mountain giant Fozruk in the Arathi Highlands. As of Battle for Azeroth, he now follows his son, also named Fozruk.

Zidormi is a bronze dragonflight and Keepers of Time representative found at various locations around the world. She offers transportation back and forth in time and space to adventurers. She is the dearest friend of Chronormu, as well as a good friend of Kalecgos.

The Zippy Copper Racer is sold by the following vendors for : * in Dalaran * in Dalaran * in Stormwind City * in Orgrimmar It can also be found inside the Stolen Present and Stolen Gift during Feast of Winter Veil.

Zul'Gurub (pronounced [ZOOL-goo-roob]) is a temple city inhabited by jungle trolls located in northeastern Stranglethorn Vale. Thousands of years ago it was the capital of the Gurubashi Empire and all jungle troll tribes affiliated with them. However, now it only serves as the capital of the Gurubashi tribe. It is an extremely dangerous place where the influence of Hakkar still persists, the trolls there are brutal, violent and fast. Many people venture there in search of treasures and artifacts. But few come out of it, if not at all.
Zild'jian was a jungle troll that sounded the war drums and informed players when the event would take place. He could be found on one of the smaller islands of the Echo Isles.
Zizo Seasizzle is a goblin fishing vendor located in Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara. He can be found by the dock, near the flight master.
Zirazi the Star-Gazer is a jungle troll portal trainer located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

Zonya the Sadist is a master Pet Tamer located at a fork in the road along Webwinder Path in Stonetalon Mountains. She is surrounded by her three battle pets: Acidous (level 7 spider), Constrictor (level 7 snake), and Odoron (level 7 skunk). Defeating her is required to complete the Taming Kalimdor and Taming Azeroth achievements.

Ziya is a sergeant in the Bilgewater Cartel. She grew up in Pyrix, an Undermine "sluicetown". Like many other goblins during the evacuation of Kezan, she was briefly enslaved by Trade Prince Jastor Gallywix. As such, she is not very fond of him and participated in the battle against him on the Lost Isles. Despite this fact, she, her husband, and her friends joined her Cartel's military forces, and fought many enemies, including the twilight cultists, the Alliance, the undead, the sha, the mantid, various elementals and even a dragon. One by one, she lost friends in various conflicts, and eventually, her husband in Hyjal. This has perhaps led to her hatred of the Alliance.

.]] Zul'Ahjin is a ruined troll city in southern Vol'dun, close to the southern base of Atul'Aman. It was apparently ruined during the ancient battle between Sethraliss and Mythrax. Long ago, statues of the three sethrak Keepers—Sulthis, Korthek, and Vorrik—were built around the ruins, and sethrak traveled from near and far to place tokens of their affection at the feet of the statues. When Sulthis began suspecting that Korthek was planning treachery, he hid his keystone to Atul'Aman in Zul'Ahjin and recorded a message for Vorrik before being killed by Korthek. __NOTOC__ Zorza is a jungle troll located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. He found Tinsy Gleamsprocket and Taravos trapped in a hunting snare, freed them and lead them to the safety of the city.
__NOTOC__ Zinfandormu is a bronze dragon located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. He is surrounded by bottles of Magically Vintaged Wine.
Zovaal's Versatile Vittles is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. It can also be purchased from broker vendors in the tower.

__NOTOC__ Zzarc'Vul is an ogre who resides at Vul'Gol Ogre Mound in southern Duskwood. He is the champion and leader of the Splinter Fist clan. In order to complete his device to study the stars, Viktori Prism'Antras sent an adventurer to defeat Zzarc'Vul and get his monocle.

There is one 5-piece set of armor for each class, and a list of unique enchants. These set items and the enchants are obtained by completing quests. Zybarus of Darnassus is a night elf stable master located in Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. He is one of the inhabitants of Wintergarde Village saved by the player during Flight of the Wintergarde Defender; therefore, he can be found at the keep only after the completion of this quest. For some unknown reason, Zybarus talks in third person.

For most of his life, the goblin engineer Zykos "Goldknuckle" Gazzo has been obsessed with mad schemes around technology. He believes technology can do anything. Like most goblins, the primary reason for his interest is the acquisition of wealth. Some years ago, he became convinced that he had discovered a technological key to unlimited riches. He has spent most of his career struggling to refine his processes, meeting with failure every time. With each attempt, he has built larger and larger devices, hoping perhaps that a larger scale would permit success, and paying no heed to the increasing dangerousness and instability of his devices. in Render's Rock.]] The 12th Sabre Regiment is a mounted cavalry unit of the Stormwind Army. During the battle of Stonewatch Keep, the Blackrock orcs killed most of the regiment and captured Corporal John J. Keeshan, imprisoning him at Render's Rock in the Redridge Mountains. He was eventually rescued by Alliance adventurers mandated by Magistrate Solomon.

The 13th brigade is an infantry unit of the Stormwind Army. During the Vashj'ir campaign, the brigade was preparing an attack on several Horde ships, when the kraken Ozumat suddenly destroyed their boat. The survivors were captured by the naga and imprisoned at the Clutch, where they were placed inside pearly bubbles that allowed them to breathe, before being taken somewhere else and never seen again. After a week, one of the soldiers managed to escape and broke a bunch of bubbles, freeing some of his comrades. A Cool Twenty Years is a meta-achievement available during WoW's Anniversary. It rewards the mount. Despite being named for the 20th Anniversary, and categorized as a Feat of Strength, it can still be completed in subsequent years.

A Prime Ordeal is a world event achievement earned during the season of the Brawler's Guild by opting into the challenge gambit with at Bizmo's Brawlpub or at Brawl'gar Arena. This is one of the criteria of Brawl Star. With this gambit, the arena is filled with tar that drastically reduces movement speed. Additionally, gouts of fire pop out of the ground every now and then that deal a non-trivial amount of damage if players stand in the fire.

Abductor Arzda is a void ethereal located at the Sureki Command in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Ab'xal is a nerubian located in the Burrows in the City of Threads.

The Abandoned Sentinel is an arcane golem located in delves as a Strange Disturbance during Midnight Season 1. Killing it will spawn a gauntlet that contains the Rock'em Sock'em Sentinel Gauntlets delve power.

Accomplished Skyrider is located next to Lord Andestrasz by the Dragonriding trainer and the Rostrum of Transformation in Valdrakken and in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City. The rider is wearing the seven-piece Drake Racer's attire, which can be purchased a few yards away from Maztha in exchange for 140x Riders of Azeroth Badge.
Abyssal Gaze is a Havoc demon hunter ability. It is the transformed version of Eye Beam during Metamorphosis (Havoc) with the Demonic Intensity hero talent.
Abyss Anglers: Proper Procedure is an exploration achievement earned for using the Surface! ability during an Abyss Anglers dive with less than 10 seconds of breath remaining.
Accolades for the Umbral Contender is available once the Midnight Keystone Myth: Season 1 feat of strength has been completed.

The Abyssal Swirl is a fishing pool that can be created from another pool in the waters around the Coiled Isle by using the Eerie Bauble, only obtainable from Second Mate Sluggs. It allows an angler to catch the Ephemeral Star Ooze, drawing the attention of the mysterious Three-Eyed Fish and starting the questline to obtain the battle pet of the same name.
Accolades for the Venomous Contender is available once the Midnight Keystone Myth: Season 2 feat of strength has been completed.

Adland is an earthen located in the Royal Library in Stormwind City. He can be found listening to the stories of Shauna Strattonmeier.

Adelgonn is the Stoneward of Dornogal. She served as the head and representative of the Stonebound in the Council of Dornogal. Following the creation of the Unbound, she eventually renounced her title and the Edicts and left the city to join them, becoming their leader. However, after recent events, the Unbound were welcomed back into Dornogal, and Adelgonn became the Stoneward once more.
Adrenaline is a passive ability used by Mr. Long-Legs during a Pet Battle.
Adherent Sol-Shapers are arakkoa found at the Apexis Chamber and Leorajh's Den in the Spires of Arak. They can also be seen flying at the Apexis Excavation during Hot Seat.

Adherent Gale-Spinners are arakkoa that spawn at Syth's camp at the Undergrowth in the Spires of Arak during All Due Respect. Dead ones can also be found at Ishaal's Hut with Shattered Hand banners planted on their corpses.
Admiral's Chandelier is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from Mountain Sounds. Additional copies can be purchased from Delphine in Tiragarde Sound for .
Admiral's Low-Hanging Chandelier is housing decor purchased from Delphine in Tiragarde Sound for after completing Mountain Sounds.

Aemyra Acton is an Arathi located in Velhan's Claim in Hallowfall. She and Taenar Strongoth were sent to investigate Velhan's Claim after its Dawntower went out. She sent adventurers to help comfort the citizens of the island and reassure them that the Lamplighters would drive back the kobyss. Despite Duke Velhan's insistence to live in peace, Aemyra armed the citizens with spears gathered from kobyss. Because her mission to Velhan's Claim took longer than expected, her boyfriend Orren Masyn had an adventurer deliver her flowers, and in turn she asked them to help write him a love letter. Aemyra and Orren later joined the Flame's Radiance to defend Hallowfall from the Sureki.

Aegor Irynbawnd is an Arathi located at Lorel's Crossing in Hallowfall. He tries to keep tabs on Lamplighters in the field and assess what areas of Hallowfall may be in need of their aid. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Aegor answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. He was stationed outside Mereldar.

Adventurer Dawncrests are the first of five upgrade currencies in Midnight Season 1, and are used to upgrade gear on the Adventurer track only from ilvl 224-237. After reaching item level 237 in every slot, players will earn the Adventurer of the Dawn feat of strength and be able to convert Adventurer Dawncrests to Veteran Dawncrests at a 3-to-1 ratio. In addition, they are contained in the Preyseeker's Satchel of Adventurer Dawncrests from Prey, and can be downgraded from Veteran Dawncrests by purchasing a Bundle of Adventurer Dawncrests. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade

Affixes are gameplay modifiers that alter combat mechanics, environmental hazards, or player interactions across various World of Warcraft systems. Originally introduced as rotating challenges in Mythic+ dungeons, affixes now appear in multiple contexts such as Delves and the :Heroic World Tier as part of WoW Remix: Legion. They serve as scalable design elements that increase difficulty, encourage strategic adaptation, and enhance replayability across seasonal and instanced content.

Alara'shinu is a secret warglaive, added in Patch 10.2, Guardians of the Dream. The method of acquisition was discovered by members of the WoW Secret Finding Discord on 23 December 2023. With the warglaive equipped (or transmogged over another weapon), the demon hunter's movement abilities like Fel Rush, Infernal Strike, and Vengeful Retreat will leave a trail of flowers behind.

Albert Henson is a Forsaken located in the Waking Shores and Azj-Kahet. He first appeared at the Dragonscale Basecamp in the Waking Shores as Pathfinder Henson, looking through a telescope from the main camp. After Dalaran's crash, he appeared as Albert in Pillar-nest Xesh at the City of Threads, having been part of a team of Pathfinders who went on a mission that went wrong when they were ambushed. With his friends and eyes eaten, Albert renounced being a Pathfinder but still wanted vengeance for his teammates. As an adventurer went to kill the Scalpel of Xishirra, Albert was eaten by spiders. His skull was then taken to Pathfinder Jeb.
Alementals of Funk are alementals summoned by Ashtar in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City during Auction House Dance Party.

burning with alchemical fire.]] Alchemical fire, also known as Liquid Fire, is a very flammable potion created through alchemy. The formula itself is complex and requires several reagents, including Heartbloom, Volatile Sap, Saltpeter, and Sulfur. Its preparation calls for the careful incorporation of hearthbloom into the mixture. Several drops of volatile sap are then added while keeping the vessel stable to prevent disruption of the contents. Saltpeter is introduced afterward to strengthen the concoction, followed by sulfur, whose addition produces noticeable fumes during the reaction. Founded under the Alliance of Lordaeron to oppose the Orcish Horde during the Second War, it has since become the Alliance Forces' ground army, safeguarding the modern faction's interests throughout Azeroth and beyond. During their numerous campaigns against the Horde and other threats to the world, they are bolstered with a wide variety of artillery and siege engines, and are further supported in their operations by the Alliance navy and the Alliance air force. Amy Lychenstone is an Arathi located in Mereldar in Hallowfall. She picks flowers near Klayn Thysthand and brings them to a memorial in the northeastern part of town. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Amy answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. She was stationed at Faerin's Advance in Azj-Kahet.

Andi'thur helps Tyrande spy on the Druids of the Flame' incursion in the Emerald Dream. After Fyrakk's death, Andi'thur is found atop the Terrace of the Moon in Amirdrassil.

Ando the Gat is a goblin vendor located upstairs in the Incontinental Hotel during Liberation of Undermine. He sells mounts gated by the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club.

Andryck Carltyn is an Arathi stationed at Beledar's Bounty in Hallowfall. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Andryck answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance.
Anduin's Despairs are shades that spawn during the Anduin Wrynn encounter at Domination's Grasp in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. Defeating one will grant Anduin 18 willpower.

Anduin's Doubts are projections that spawn during the Anduin Wrynn encounter at Domination's Grasp in the Sepulcher of the First Ones. They will slowly move towards Anduin. Defeating one will grant Anduin 4 willpower.

Angel of Death is a powerful Klaxxi Enhancement granted by Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes, summoning Kil'ruk for a quick high-damage cleaving strike every 60 seconds. Like all Klaxxi buffs, it remains on the adventurer indefinitely while in the Dread Wastes and is automatically reapplied upon re-entry to the zone, but is replaced if a different Enhancement is selected.

Angorla is an earthen located in Flotsam Shoal on the Siren Isle. She was first seen tending to Helpful Haulbot. Afterward, Bargus asked her to analyze a ring and a citrine. The adventurer assisted her with repairing the citrine, and she then directed the hero to socket it into the ring. She was excited about its power. Although Dawn encouraged the earthen to explore the isle, Angorla was busy at her forge, so she asked the adventurer to search the isle for more crystals. Once the hero returned with fragments, she merged them, creating a new shard. Later, in a conversation with Dawn, she admitted she heard the Siren Crystal sing to her, inspiring her to work with the crystals.
Angler's Delight is made with Khaz Algar Cooking (45). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.

Angry Needlers are gorm flyer found as pets of Niya at the Crucible of the Damned and Gorgoa: River of Souls in the Maw during That's Going to Sting. They carry Duarri, Gkeca, and Throgtu off into the air after the player uses the Angry Needler Nest on them and then kills them.
Anomaly Detection Mark I is an ability that can be purchased for 200 Dragon Isles Supplies from the Tier 2 row of the Expedition Supply Kit.

Another Timely Invitation begins the WoW's Anniversary storyline with a breadcrumb to the Caverns of Time. This quest may be marked by the usual exclamation symbol on the Stormwind City and Orgrimmar zone maps without actually being available. It may be possible to clear it when the next anniversary celebration begins.

Antique Bronze Bullion can be handed in to several vendors at the Parting Glass in Valdrakken, for equipment, cosmetics, and Jigglesworth, Sr.. One bullion will drop per week from raid bosses in Dragonflight Season 4 in Awakened Raids, regardless of difficulty. The cap increases by one per week, and additional bullion will drop until players catch up. When purchased, Awakened gear starts at ilvl 493 at upgrade level 1/12, equivalent to Normal raid gear at 1/8 on the Champion track.

Apex Canopy is an area found in the Waking Shores, south of Dragonbane Keep and east of Uktulut Outpost. The area consists of several valleys and plateaus, including the Apex Observatory. Large numbers of vorquin, basilisks, and proto-dragons can be found here. The area is occasionally the site of a Grand Hunt, during which Shikaar hunters and Ohuna will be present. The area contains several notable features. On a large plateau is a small settlement, featuring red dragonflight banners, dead vorquin, and an Ancient Monument accessible to blacksmiths. To the west is a large tower, occupied by Ol' Hestorath. In the valley is a large cave occupied by vorquin, the entrance of which is flanked by

Apex Observatory is a location in the Waking Shores, within the Apex Canopy. The observatory is now in ruins and has been made into a camp by the Red Dragonflight and Dragonscale Expedition. Large numbers of animal bones are present alongside several captive proto-dragons and a basilisk, indicating they are studying the wildlife of the Apex Canopy.

Arathor Scouts are Arathi located in Deadfin Mire on the Siren Isle while Tides of Greed is active. They have been charmed by the island's sirens and now fight for them. After being freed, they become friendly to the adventurer and cheer before running away.

, the leader and famous archaeologist of the Explorers' League.]] Archaeologists are explorers and scholars who search the world - and places beyond - for mysterious remnants of the past. Their digs unearth all manner of artifacts, and a persistent archaeologist will research commonplace historical items alongside rare and powerful relics. They usually survey maps of Azeroth to find the locations of promising dig sites, then investigate with survey tools in an attempt to narrow down the location of the most precious historical fragments in those areas.
